actions.name: convert_board_to_project
actions.description: Convert an existing monday.com board into a project with enhanced project management capabilities. This mutation transforms a regular board by applying project-specific features and configurations through column mappings that define how existing board columns should be interpreted in the project context. The conversion process is asynchronous and returns a process_id for tracking completion. Optionally accepts a callback URL for notification when the conversion completes. Use this when you have an existing board with data that needs to be upgraded to a full project with advanced project management features like Resource Planner integration.
actions.select: success message projectId process_id

args.name: input
args.description: The input (ConvertBoardToProjectInput!). An object (ConvertBoardToProjectInput) with: board_id (ID!); column_mappings (ColumnsMappingInput!); callback_url (String)

actions.name: create_project
actions.description: Create a new project in monday.com from scratch. This mutation initiates asynchronous project creation with comprehensive customization options including: privacy settings (private/public - share is currently not supported), optional companions like Resource Planner for enhanced project management capabilities, workspace assignment for organizational structure, folder placement for better organization, and template selection for predefined project structures. Since project creation is asynchronous, you can optionally provide a callback_url where the project ID will be sent via POST request once creation completes. The callback will receive: { is_success: boolean, process_id: string, project_id?: number }. Returns a process_id for tracking the creation request.
actions.select: success message error process_id

args.name: input
args.description: The input (CreateProjectInput!). An object (CreateProjectInput) with: name (String!): The name of the project to create; board_kind (BoardKind!): The project's privacy setting (public / private); template_id (ID): Optional template id to create the project from. Currently only supported for solution templates; companions ([String!]): Optional list of companion features to enable (currently only "resource_planner"); workspace_id (String): Optional workspace ID to associate with the project; folder_id (String): Optional folder ID to associate with the project; callback_url (String): Optional external callback URL where the project ID will be sent after async creation. The callback will receive a POST request with { is_success: boolean, process_id: string, project_id?: number }

actions.name: submit_api_feedback
actions.description: Report a bug, a missing capability, a documentation problem or general feedback about the monday API. Do NOT include any personally identifiable information (PII) such as names, email addresses, phone numbers, or any other personal data.
actions.select: success feedback_id

args.name: input
args.description: The input (SubmitApiFeedbackInput!). An object (SubmitApiFeedbackInput) with: kind (ApiFeedbackKind!): The type of feedback: a bug, a feature request, a documentation problem, or general feedback.; title (String!): What you were trying to do, in plain words, for example "move an item to the top of its group". 1-200 characters. Do NOT include any personally identifiable information (PII) such as names, email addresses, phone numbers, or any other personal data.; description (String!): The details of the report, 1-3000 characters. Say what you tried, what you expected and what you got. For a feature_request, describe the action you need in monday product terms, and say whether you found a workaround and what it was. Do NOT include any personally identifiable information (PII) such as names, email addresses, phone numbers, or any other personal data.; field_path (String): The schema coordinate the report is about, for example Mutation.reorder_items or Item.column_values. If the field does not exist, give the name you expected. Up to 200 characters.; error_code (String): The error code you received, for example COMPLEXITY_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED. Up to 100 characters.; request_id (String): The request_id from the extensions of the earlier API call's response that this report is about, if you have it. Up to 128 characters.; outcome (ApiFeedbackOutcome): What you did next after you hit the problem: gave up, did it in the monday UI, worked around it with other API calls, or something else.
